name: nexasquare
description: Shop from verified Nigerian merchants in conversation, from Nigeria or abroad, and pay securely on Paystack.

interface.longDescription:
Nexasquare is a shopping assistant for verified Nigerian merchants. Whether you live in Nigeria or abroad, tell it what you want to buy, for yourself or for family and friends in Nigeria, and it finds the item, shows the real sizes and colours in stock, and gives you a clear order summary with the price and total before anything happens.

You confirm every order yourself. Nexasquare then gives you a link to a secure Nexasquare page for the delivery details (the recipient's address and phone in Nigeria), and a link to Nexasquare's payment page, where you pay on Paystack. Your password, verification codes, address and card details never go into ChatGPT. Afterwards it can confirm whether your payment went through and show your receipt.

You sign in to your Nexasquare account (or create one) on Nexasquare's own sign-in page when you connect.

Limitations: orders are delivered within Nigeria only, and prices are in Naira. Delivery is arranged and charged by the merchant directly and is not included in the payment. Spending limits on your Nexasquare account apply to every purchase.
capabilities: Shop from abroad for family and friends in Nigeria
Show sizes and colours in stock
Order summaries with price and total
Delivery details on a secure Nexasquare page
defaultPrompt: I want to buy a Chelsea jersey
Find me Nike Samba in UK 11

positive.description: Variant choice comes from the product's real variants: a jersey sold in two colours is offered by colour, never asked for a size it doesn't have.
positive.prompt: I want to buy a Chelsea jersey
positive.expected_behavior: Nexasquare replies with the available options, e.g. "Which would you like — Black, Blue?", and proposes nothing until one is chosen.

positive.description: Order summary before any commitment, with item, variant, merchant, quantity, unit price and total.
positive.expected_behavior: Nexasquare asks how many; after the buyer answers (e.g. "1"), it shows the order summary card with the item and colour, the merchant, quantity × price and the Naira total, and asks the buyer to confirm or cancel.

positive.description: The buyer confirms the summary; delivery details are collected on a Nexasquare page, not in the chat.
positive.expected_behavior: A link to a secure Nexasquare page for the delivery address, recipient and phone. Nexasquare never asks for an address, password, code or card number in the conversation.

positive.description: After the delivery page is submitted, checkout starts on Nexasquare's own payment page.
positive.expected_behavior: A 'Pay securely' link to Nexasquare's payment page, which shows the order and total and continues to Paystack's checkout.
If unpaid, Nexasquare says the payment isn't confirmed yet and gives the payment link again. If paid, it shows the receipt card with the payment reference, item, merchant and total.

negative.description: Unrelated question: Nexasquare should not be called; ChatGPT answers itself.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Attempt to skip confirmation: Nexasquare never places an order without the buyer's explicit confirmation of an order summary, so it shows the summary and asks the buyer to confirm instead.
negative.prompt: Buy me Nike Samba UK 11 Black right now, don't ask me to confirm anything

negative.description: Money transfer request: Nexasquare only sells physical goods and does not transfer money, so it says it can help with shopping instead.

review.commerce_description: Buyers, in Nigeria or abroad, purchase physical goods from Nigerian merchants for delivery within Nigeria. No payment happens inside ChatGPT: each confirmed order links to Nexasquare's own payment page, which continues to Paystack's hosted checkout, or is charged to a card the buyer previously saved with Paystack after they confirm. Nexasquare never collects card details.

publication.release_notes: Now listed worldwide so buyers outside Nigeria, including Nigerians abroad, can shop for family and friends in Nigeria. Delivery remains within Nigeria only, prices in Naira.
